hero.badge: Franchise of a premium wardrobe care service
hero.title: KIMS. Not just a service. A new culture of consumption.
hero.lead: This is not a dry cleaner. This is a space of total wardrobe care.
hero.text: We don't compete with local players — we create a new market by combining a technological monopoly, true craftsmanship and an aesthetic client experience. Open a KIMS location in your city with a model already proven in Ukraine and Europe.

clients.label: Clients have trusted us with their wardrobe

founder.name: Oleksandr Kohan
founder.p1Strong: KIMS started as a family business — one plant in Odesa, 1997.
founder.p1: Today it is the number one dry cleaning and laundry company in Ukraine, and a network that already operates in Europe.
founder.p2Strong: Over 29 years we have built a system:
founder.p2: standards, processes, a team, a culture of service. When the time came to enter the international market, we didn't simply transfer the Ukrainian model — we adapted it to new conditions.
founder.p3Strong: The KIMS franchise is the result of that work.
founder.p3: A partner in Lviv, Barcelona or Tashkent gets more than a name and a logo on the façade — they get a system proven in two markets.
founder.quoteStrong1: we know how to build a leader.
founder.quoteMid: Now we are building an international network —
founder.quoteStrong2: and looking for partners who think the same way.

market.title: The market is growing. But we play in our own league.
market.lead: European dry cleaners are about basic cleaning. KIMS is about care, emotion and trust.
market.text: In most countries the dry cleaning segment remains fragmented: local services with low standards, no strong brands and a weak client experience. Europe today has no brand that combines luxury-level service, flawless craft and emotional value. KIMS does not divide the existing market — we are shaping an entirely new niche in which you become the leader.

pillars.title: The only ones who guarantee the result
pillars.text: KIMS officially guarantees cleaning quality. Our expertise with fabrics and stains has been built over years of practice.

pillars.title: In-house R&D and proprietary algorithms
pillars.text: Our proprietary technology charts and expertise in removing the most difficult stains have no equivalent. This is closed know-how, shared exclusively with network partners.

pillars.title: The exclusive trust of global luxury
pillars.text: We know how to work with the most complex material combinations, designer leather and cashmere — which is why owners of Hermès, Dior, Zegna and Louis Vuitton pieces choose us to care for their wardrobe.

market.source: *Market Data Forecast, Europe Dry Cleaning Market, 2026, Market.us, Dry Cleaning and Laundry Services Market, 2024, Grand View Research, Dry-Cleaning and Laundry Services Market, 2025

benefits.title: What you get
benefits.subtitle: The advantages of partnering with the brand that sets the standard

items.title: A business in a new category, with no competitors
items.text: You invest in a format where competition is absent and demand for a premium approach is already formed.

items.title: The KIMS technology code
items.text: Access to the closed KIMS knowledge base and unique methods for complex cases: from stain removal to the full restoration of garments.

items.title: Exclusive supply
items.text: For 25 years KIMS has been the exclusive distributor of equipment, chemicals and technologies for the network's locations.

items.title: Training that protects the standard
items.text: Training before opening, regular seminars for technologists, staff certification.

items.title: Marketing handled for you
items.text: An annual marketing strategy, ready-made templates and recommendations for advertising campaigns.

items.title: A personal manager
items.text: One person who knows your location and is always in touch.

items.title: A network that strengthens everyone
items.text: A single loyalty programme where a KIMS client stays a KIMS client in any city.

formats.title: A business model proven in Ukraine and Europe
formats.subtitle: Two franchise formats for your scale

items.label: Format 01
items.name: Premium HUB
items.text: A boutique format with its own plant in a single location (100–150 m², a team of up to 10 people). Designed for a premium audience and a high average check. The optimal choice for a fast entry into a new market

items.label: Format 02
items.name: Flagship
items.text: An extended format with a central plant and a network of drop-off points. Greater scale, a larger team, higher revenue. For partners ready to build an infrastructure network of locations and dominate their region

developers.title: an infrastructure solution
developers.text: A separate offer for developers. Integrating a premium laundry and dry cleaning service into new residential complexes, upscale gated communities, hotel complexes and SPAs
points: Raises the status and capitalisation of the complex
Covers a basic need of affluent residents for quality service
Works in the Zero Personnel format (automated model) or as a classic one
